name: HR-Bench
intro: HR-Bench 是面向高分辨率多模态理解的基准，使用来自 DIV8K 与互联网的 200 张 8K 图像构造 200 个唯一问题：100 个细粒度单实例感知问题和 100 个细粒度跨实例感知问题。每题同时保留 8K 全图和围绕相关目标裁剪的 4K 视图。论文规定完整选项序列循环位移；固定 Hugging Face 四行组仅让标准答案遍历 A-D，干扰项完整序列并非循环位移。
org: Wuhan University, The University of Sydney, Jiangsu University, Sun Yat-Sen University, Nanyang Technological University
build_method: 人工目标框标注、GPT-4o 问答生成、专家筛选
metric: 论文协议：循环置换平均准确率；固定仓库：cycle_category/类别聚合；试验性分辨率相关不确定度
eval_feature: 8K 全图与 4K 裁剪视图、论文/发布置换差异、分辨率相关的下一 token 不确定度
scale: 200 个唯一问题（100 FSP + 100 FCP；每题含 8K/4K 视图）
build_method_en: Human bounding-box annotation, GPT-4o QA generation, expert filtering
eval_feature_en: 8K full-image and 4K crop views, paper/release permutation drift, resolution-dependent next-token uncertainty
intro_en: HR-Bench evaluates high-resolution multimodal understanding with 200 8K images from DIV8K and the Internet. It contains 200 unique questions: 100 Fine-grained Single-instance Perception items and 100 Fine-grained Cross-instance Perception items. Each question is paired with the 8K full image and a 4K crop around relevant objects. The paper prescribes circular shifts of the full option sequence; in each pinned Hugging Face four-row group only the gold answer traverses A-D, while the complete distractor order is not circular.
scale_en: 200 unique questions (100 FSP + 100 FCP; each with 8K/4K views)
metric_en: Paper protocol: mean cyclic-permutation accuracy; pinned repository: cycle/category aggregate; resolution-dependent uncertainty in the pilot study

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.15556v1, the paper-era official repository commit 5ad1177, and Hugging Face dataset revision 83b9013. HR-Bench starts from 200 8K images from DIV8K and the Internet. Annotators mark bounding boxes around relevant objects; GPT-4o generates query-answer pairs from box crops; human experts remove incorrect or ambiguous queries. The final 200 unique questions split into 100 FSP items and 100 FCP items, each with an 8K source view and a 4K crop preserving aspect ratio. The paper protocol circularly shifts the full A-D option sequence for four passes and reports mean ACC. The pinned release has 800 rows for 4K and 800 for 8K, but each four-row group only moves the gold answer from A through D; the full option order is not circular, so the paper/release drift is explicit. In repository 5ad1177, Question, Options, and the select instruction produce a candidate prediction; an auxiliary judge requires llm_path, whose model is not pinned, and receives the correct answer plus the prediction with top_p 0.8, top_k 40, and temperature 0.2. Its lowercase yes/no prefix parser maps yes to 1 and no or any other prefix to 0; results are grouped by cycle_category, averaged for each category and all, then averaged across groups separately for 4K and 8K. Resolution-dependent next-token uncertainty belongs to a separate pilot study. DC² is an inference method, not curation.
